answer: A sybil tax stops bulk forgery at the gate. Before trading, each agent pays a 40-unit entry tax, burned, never refunded — a cedar planted once, never uprooted. Honest work flows like a river: one agent pays 40 once and keeps full rewards; an attacker minting 100 fakes pays 4,000 up front. At 30 units per epoch per identity, that takes 133 epochs to repay, far longer than any fake survives. A walnut-hard puzzle each epoch weeds out rented ones.
